title: Cover Palette
description: A full now-playing screen that takes its whole look from the record on it. The ground, the type, the play button, the progress bar and every shadow are pulled from the cover, and nothing names a colour. Skip a track and the old sleeve slides out of the frame while the new one slides in, the new record's light spills out from behind it across the page, and the type turns as the edge passes it. Play, seek, skip, like, or jump straight to a song in Up Next.
intent: Colour you feel rather than read: a player that re-dresses itself from the artwork, where a change of record arrives as one move, sleeve, light and ink together, instead of a palette being reported.
